description: This PHP script provides user management functionalities within the TestLink project. It includes operations for creating, editing, resetting passwords, generating API keys for users, and rendering user management interfaces. The script interacts with the database, handles form inputs, sends emails, manages user sessions, and interfaces with external libraries such as Zend Framework for hostname validation.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user entity within the TestLink system, with methods for database interactions and property management.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents user roles, providing methods to retrieve role information.

classes.name: APIKey
classes.description: Handles API key generation and management for users.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: A Smarty template engine wrapper for rendering UI components.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters, returning them as an object.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database based on provided arguments.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing user record with new data from arguments.

methods.name: createNewPassword
methods.description: Generates and assigns a new password for a user, possibly sending it via email.

methods.name: createNewAPIKey
methods.description: Creates a new API key for a user and optionally emails it.

methods.name: initializeUserProperties
methods.description: Sets user object properties based on input data, sanitizing as needed.

methods.name: decodeRoleId
methods.description: Retrieves the role name given a role ID.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Displays the appropriate UI template based on the action being performed.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares GUI data structures for user management interface.

methods.name: initLabels
methods.description: Initializes UI labels used in the user management screens.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to manage users.
